video_title: Casey Holdahl on Blazers Departure, plus Blazers Broadcast and Preseason Reaction | Blazers Podcast

quotes.speaker: Casey Holdahl
quotes.summary_phrase: Casey Holdahl on his departure from the Portland Trail Blazers
quotes.excerpt: I worked for the team for 18 years, and covered the team for two years before that.
quotes.quote: I worked for the team for 18 years, and covered the team for two years before that. Obviously, there is a new coaching staff, or at least mostly a new coaching staff, and a number of, well, one important new player in Jabari Walker, I would say, and obviously the return of Damian Lillard. So, I would say my first winner would be just the fans in Moda Center last night getting to watch Dame play. I know that's been really important to this community and this organization.

quotes.speaker: Casey Holdahl
quotes.summary_phrase: Casey Holdahl on the NBA moving broadcasts to the 100-level
quotes.excerpt: It's more and more common now in the NBA that they're moving broadcasters off of the floor.
quotes.quote: It's more and more common now in the NBA that they're moving broadcasters off of the floor and more to the top of the 100-level. So where Travis Demers and Damian Lillard were at last night, that's their new position. And if you're familiar with press row at the Moda Center, it's at the top of the 100-level. They're in that area now. So you should just be radio broadcast was there, now I believe it's both radio and television broadcast. So that's where Lamar and Travis were at.

quotes.speaker: Casey Holdahl
quotes.summary_phrase: Casey Holdahl on his departure and the Blazers' organizational changes
quotes.excerpt: The idea that there was all this fat to be trimmed and that there was people that just weren't doing anything, that's not true.
quotes.quote: The idea that there was all this fat to be trimmed and that there was people that just weren't doing anything, that's not true. That's never been true. And you are definitely going to see some differences this year, up and down the organization. And I think the first one you really saw was on that broadcast last night. And again, I think the caveat there would be, it's preseason, it's the first one of the year. It's always going to take a little time to get things up and running, but it's going to look a lot different, and I would be surprised if it looked better.

quotes.speaker: Casey Holdahl
quotes.summary_mention: Casey Holdahl on Robert Williams III's health and impact
quotes.excerpt: I've heard from a number of people during training camp that Rob has looked awesome.
quotes.quote: I've heard from a number of people during training camp that Rob has looked awesome. That he has looked so good. And every time Rob gets an extended period of time where he can actually play, people are like, good god, this guy is awesome. And he is. If Rob had been healthy his entire career, he's a Hall of Famer, and I don't doubt that for one second. It's just as everyone knows, it's just always been the health. So, yeah, that's a really good center tandem, and yeah, Rob looked great.

quotes.speaker: Casey Holdahl
quotes.summary_phrase: Casey Holdahl on Damian Lillard's reasons for returning to Portland
quotes.excerpt: That was kind of one of the main reasons that Dame wanted to come back to Portland was because of two guys.
quotes.quote: That was kind of one of the main reasons that Dame wanted to come back to Portland was because of two guys, was because of Jusuf Nurkic and Anfernee Simons. And I think that their game this year, I think is going to be even that much better because he's going to have guys take that pressure off of him. Because I think, you know, I think we noticed towards the end of the season that it was like, just asking probably a little bit too much from him. And particularly once he had the injury, you know, that that made it even harder.

quotes.speaker: Casey Holdahl
quotes.summary_phrase: Casey Holdahl on Damian Lillard helping him find work
quotes.excerpt: When I lost my job, he made a point of getting me work.
quotes.quote: When I lost my job, he made a point of getting me work. And another guy, Tucker, who was on the digital team who also got let go. So he has a sponsorship with Tissot, and they wanted to do an interview with Dame at his place for some internal meetings they were having. And so when they were like, pitching that to him, and Dame's like, yeah, sure we can do that. And they're like, okay, well, we're going to get a, a woman to to do the interview and we'll bring in a, a crew to to shoot it. Dame was like, no. He's like, Casey's doing the interview and Tucker's shooting it. Because he knew that we just lost our jobs, we needed work, like, and for someone to to look out for you like that, who's Damian Lillard, like, everything anyone says about Dame, about how, how great of a guy he is and how much he actually really cares about people, it's 100% true.

quotes.speaker: Casey Holdahl
quotes.summary_phrase: Casey Holdahl on the Blazers' front office staff cuts
quotes.excerpt: There were people that got let go that you would never know their names or what they did.
quotes.quote: There were people that got let go that you would never know their names or what they did. And Dame would be like, that's a real, that's a real bummer. I'm upset about that. So like, to to be present in some of the most exciting times in Portland and not even just in sports, but just like for the city, to to be in the building and to to be able to tell some of those stories, to to develop the relationships I, I've been able to develop with players and and staff on the team, and really have that mean something to me, you know, that's really my my biggest takeaway is how lucky I am to to have had that experience.
